title: Tune Dependabot so its PRs match the runtime and peer pins
description: Follow-up from the first Dependabot run after TASK-1.24 (2026-11-19): it opened PR #2 bumping @types/node 22.20.5 -> 26.6.6 although the app runs on Node 22, and its npm job failed updating typescript because typescript-eslint is a peer that must move with it (ETARGET for @typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin@8.73.0 inside the cooldown window). Revisits assumption A-3 (no ignore rules).

nodes.title: Tune Dependabot so its PRs match the runtime and peer pins
Bootstrap the strict TypeScript project with one-command checks
Run every check in GitHub Actions on each push and pull request
Protect main and keep CI action pins current
Confirm Dependabot runs and clear merged doit branches after the first push

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given .github/dependabot.yml, When Dependabot evaluates @types/node, Then it ignores semver-major updates so @types/node stays on the Node major used by CI and engines (22)

Given a new typescript release, When Dependabot runs, Then typescript and typescript-eslint packages are updated in the same grouped PR (or typescript waits until typescript-eslint supports it) and the npm update job completes without a peer-dependency error
Given the config change, When tests/ci/dependabot.acceptance.test.ts runs, Then it pins the @types/node ignore rule and the typescript grouping
